s.how: Cook 300g sushi rice and season with vinegar and sugar. Spread over 4 nori sheets, fill with 200g salmon and avocado and roll tight with a mat. Slice with a wet knife. Serve with soy and pickled ginger. Smile and wave, boys.

Melt 150g dark chocolate with 120g butter, whisk in 200g sugar and 2 eggs and fold in 80g flour. Beat 200g cream cheese with 50g sugar and 1 egg. Spread the brownie in a tin and swirl the cheesecake through in stripes. Bake at 170C for 30 minutes.

m.note: the steak Alex dreams about in the zoo
m.how: Dry-brine 4 rib eyes overnight. Sear in a smoking cast iron pan, flipping every minute, and pull at 54C. Rest 8 minutes and top with 60g butter mashed with garlic and parsley. Fry 1kg potatoes cut into shoestrings.

w.how: Cut a pineapple into thick wedges and grill until charred. Melt 60g butter with 80g brown sugar and 2 tbsp dark rum until glossy and pour over. Serve straight away with scoops of coconut ice cream.

d.note: the welcome party on the island
d.how: Mix 500ml mango nectar with the pulp of 3 passionfruit. Pour over plenty of ice in four glasses and top with lemonade. Add a lime wedge to each.
